data.name: TRACE (Transit Recognition And Classification Engine for exoplanet detection)
data.description: Built TRACE (Transit Recognition And Classification Engine), a ML pipeline that detects and classifies exoplanet transits from noisy TESS light curves as part of the Bharat Antariksh Hackathon 2026

data.name: Zone-Based Crowd Occupancy Estimation via Multi-Object Tracking
data.description: Built a real-time crowd density estimation pipeline using YOLOv8 inference for pedestrian zone wise occupancy detection which helps flag overcrowding in public places.

data.name: Song Lyrics Genre Classifier
data.description: Developed an SVM classifier using TF-IDF and Word2Vec embeddings on NLTK-preprocessed multilingual Spotify lyrics to achieve optimal cross-genre accuracy.
